ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Culture（中世日本 - 文化）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development prototype. Adds a candidate traditional floor seat (enza), with a compiled, narrow Ingest travel-Job adapter, and makes the AteWithoutTable mood effect neutral. Includes the compiled RimWorld 1.6 AMJ.Culture meal-seat adapter. Vanilla 1.6 direct enza meal and Comfort passed a single isolated scenario; table precedence and MO compatibility not yet accepted. Provisional visuals; not approved for release.
開発用試作。円座による床座の食事機能を開発中。RimWorld 1.6用の食事処理DLLを同梱。Vanilla 1.6で円座での食事・快適性獲得を実機確認済み。食卓優先・MO互換・画像は未確定。テーブルなし食事の心情補正は0。一般公開・追加互換検証は未実施。
